run_hydra_app_with_defaults: run the Hydra app that prints MySQL config using defaults list and ConfigStore
create_mysql_config_dataclass: create a MySQLConfig dataclass with driver, host, port, user, and password fields
create_postgresql_config_dataclass: create a PostGreSQLConfig dataclass with driver, host, port, timeout, user, and password fields
store_config_in_configstore: store a config node in Hydra ConfigStore with a group name and config name
print_config_as_yaml: print the Hydra config object as YAML using OmegaConf.to_yaml
